## This repository does not accept pull requests

**At the moment we do not accept any public contributions.**

Road to ML is **maintainer-curated**. Only the maintainer updates this curriculum and the Study Hub. Content PRs are not reviewed or merged. An automation will close this PR.

Please close this PR yourself if it is still open, and read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

**To report a typo, broken link, or factual error:** open a [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/NabidAlam/road-to-machine-learning/issues/new?template=problem_report.md) (problem report only). That is not a contribution channel.

Thank you for your interest in the curriculum.
